keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Hamari Traoré (Paris FC).
Delay in match because of an injury Danny Namaso (Auxerre).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) is shown the yellow card.
Cameron Archer (Auxerre) is shown the yellow card.
Sinaly Diomandé (Auxerre) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Auxerre 0, Paris FC 0.
Goal! Auxerre 0, Paris FC 1. Lassine Sinayoko (Paris FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Pablo Pagis.
Substitution, Auxerre. Clément Akpa replaces Telli Siwe.
Substitution, Auxerre. Lamine Sy replaces Marvin Senaya.
Substitution, Paris FC. Luca Koleosho replaces Moses Simon.
Substitution, Paris FC. Patrick Zabi replaces Ilan Kebbal.
Substitution, Auxerre. Kévin Danois replaces Naouirou Ahamada.
Substitution, Auxerre. Rémy Labeau Lascary replaces Danny Namaso.
Substitution, Auxerre. Rayan Mandengue replaces Fredrik Oppegård.
Kévin Danois (Auxerre) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Paris FC. Omar Sissoko replaces Lassine Sinayoko.
Substitution, Paris FC. Moustapha Mbow replaces Pablo Pagis.
